turns.utterance: I've inspected both ends of the communication cable and checked the connectors.

ground_truth.node_text: Physically inspect the communication cable connectors at the marking controller port and at the machine programmable controller interface port. Check that both connectors are fully seated and the locking mechanism is engaged.

ground_truth.node_text: Is the network or serial communication cable physically connected at both ends (marking controller and machine programmable controller)?

turns.utterance: Reseat both connectors. If the cable is visibly damaged, kinked, crushed, or has bent connector pins, replace the communication cable.

turns.utterance: Inspect the communication port connector pins on both devices for corrosion, dust buildup, or bent pins. Check the controller ventilation slots for blockage.

turns.utterance: I've completed the inspection of the connector pins and ventilation slots on both devices.

ground_truth.node_text: Inspect the communication port connector pins on both devices for corrosion, dust build up, or bent pins. Check the controller ventilation slots for blockage.

turns.utterance: Are there contaminated connector pins or ventilation slots on the marking controller or programmable controller interface card?

turns.utterance: Clean the connector pins with a dry contact cleaner spray. Clear blocked ventilation slots with compressed air. Do not use abrasive tools on connector pins.

turns.utterance: I've completed all the checks. The network interface card shows no fault lights, power supply voltage is within specification, and the fan is running with clear ventilation.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check the network interface card for fault indicator lights. 2. Check the marking controller internal power supply output voltage. 3. Verify that the controller fan and ventilation slots are unobstructed.

turns.utterance: Are there electrical defects in the network interface card, power supply, or ground connection?

turns.utterance: All electrical components appear to be functioning normally with no defects detected.

turns.utterance: Are the communication protocol parameters such as baud rate, IP address, or port number correctly configured on both the marking controller and the machine programmable controller?

ground_truth.node_text: Are the communication protocol parameters (baud rate, IP address, or port number) correctly configured on both the marking controller and the machine programmable controller?

turns.utterance: Has the communication link been restored and is the marking controller receiving and executing marking commands correctly?

turns.utterance: Escalate to the maintenance team and marking controller supplier. The communication fault cannot be resolved through standard corrective actions.

ground_truth.node_text: Escalate to the maintenance team and marking controller supplier: the communication fault cannot be resolved through standard corrective actions.

turns.utterance: Understood, I'm escalating this issue to the maintenance team and will contact the marking controller supplier.

ground_truth.node_text: Escalate to the maintenance team and marking controller supplier: the communication fault cannot be resolved through standard corrective actions.

turns.utterance: Record all corrective actions, parameter settings, and the final communication test result in the maintenance log. Notify the quality assurance team.

ground_truth.node_text: Record all corrective actions, parameter settings, and the final communication test result in the maintenance log. Notify quality assurance team.

turns.utterance: I've documented all actions and test results in the maintenance log and notified quality assurance.

turns.utterance: Marking controller communication diagnostic procedure complete. The issue has been escalated for further investigation.

turns.utterance: Acknowledged, awaiting further support from the maintenance team.
